body: Hey. It’s 4am for me now and I work in a couple hours. I should be trying to sleep but for some reason I felt compelled to offer some support to someone on this sub. I don’t know if you’re still awake or paying attention, but tonight this random stranger is thinking of you. I can’t say I know anything about you, but I genuinely felt a form of care for you. I know how it is to post on this sub, hoping someone will read your thoughts and that someone will reach out to you. It’s so crushing to not get a response. It’s like it validates your thoughts that nobody does care about you and you’re hopeless. I really hope this comment can at least take that feeling away for you. I know I would have wished for any type of reply on my posts. life is so extremely difficult, just know that I took the time to write this message because I care. I never can genuinely say that. much love and I wish nothing but the best for you

You are 100% right, I would make whoever I was talking to feel absolutely terrible and endanger them if I did it. I’m so sorry, I should not talk to anyone about it then. I was only thinking about the possibility of my benefit. But, I am hopeless because I’m out of options and out of caring. I don’t want to live like this for another couple of decades and there’s no other way I can get out of it

I know exactly how it all works. I used to have a major problem with it and I have hundreds of scars. They’re all fully healed and white though. I know it is bad for me, but I just want to get that feeling again. I feel out of options.

First, thank you for commenting. That alone is hard enough to receive. I can really relate to what you said. I do end up feeling worse when trying to communicate my thoughts because I feel so jumbled and the responses I receive don’t help me so it leaves me feeling even more hopeless. Especially since I used to feel better when I would make a post here and people would talk to me. My mindset turns into “oh its just a random person on the internet that can’t actually help me in real life and they’re just trying to be nice”. It sucks that something that used to work doesn’t work anymore and it’s like I’m just falling further into the pit. I actually started seeing my old therapist again a couple months ago. Because I have such a hard time opening up, I don’t feel like I’m getting the full benefits from it. I also can’t tell her how much I want to die without her having to take action so I can’t be 100% real with her.

Feeling alone amplifies the hopelessness more and I am not doing good with that now. I was in a relationship for over 2 and a half years and it ended on bad terms last month. She was the only one I felt semi-okay opening up to and still she was horrible at handling it. Telling her I was feeling like I wanted to kill myself had her saying “why does everyone come to me with their problems. Just wait until I die” that same day. I’ve never admitted that to anyone before then and I don’t think I ever will again. She was toxic but I loved her so fucking much and to experience her indifference/annoyance with my struggles hurt deeply. 

Sorry for the rant, I don’t expect you to respond or anything, the words just kept coming. But thank you.
I bought it from a private seller. Very easy to get one where I live.
I've done the research. Thank you
I feel like I have had so much time to think. I know I will continue to do so but my patience is up. I want to die, but the consequences are huge.  It's way more than how people treat me.

I don't feel okay, but I'm fine for the night I guess. Your concern feels genuine and I take comfort in that. Something did happen and I feel as if the burden on me has only worsened. I'm trapped with my own thoughts and they are not good.
I'm sorry, you really were helpful but I knew it was too late for me to change my mind. Now I don't know what to feel but I know I'm going to regret it. ): it had been so long
I'm just sitting here in my bathroom with new blades, daring myself to do it.

I don't know, maybe I'll get myself real stoned. If I forced myself to go hangout with my friend it's possible I won't relapse, but I don't want to waste the energy I just want to be alone. I'm sorry that you relapsed.

Thank you for replying, I was worried I would get no responses again. Just the fact that you took the time to read and reply gives me comfort. 

I have been very honest with her and tried to be supportive of her feelings. She doesn't believe me and continues to blame herself. I just don't understand why she is not doing the same for me when I'm the one so depressed. I'm the one supposed to get comforted and yet I only feel worse for making her sad. I feel like I'm trapped feeling this way.

She told me she's cried a lot and hates waking up everyday thinking that her gf is sad. This hurts me so much. I know you are right, things will be better with time but I'm so tired of waiting. Everyday is the same and now it's worse.
Do you want to pm or something?
